text: What is Zoho One? One licence for 45+ Zoho apps.
One sign-in. One admin panel. One invoice.
Add a person once, then give them only the apps they need.
Two ways to pay. All Employee pricing licenses everyone on payroll, at a lower rate.
Flexible User pricing licenses only the people you choose, at a higher rate.
It's not everything Zoho makes. Zoho ERP, Catalyst and FSM are outside it.
In Australia, New Zealand and the UK, payroll is not included.
It suits a business using 4+ Zoho apps across several teams.
Read the full guide at zudoworks.com
